sources.actual_access: Article and repository documentation read; no generation model executed.

Code Apache-2.0; docs/skills CC-BY-4.0.

sources.actual_access: Primary indexed full article and corroborating Google announcement read; direct article open returned tool error. No model access, waitlist enrollment or execution.

sources.actual_access: Article read. No account access, robot control or API execution.

candidates.name: Counterfactual experience foundry for recoverable robot work
candidates.priority: Strongest newly justified investigation, not selected flagship
candidates.blue_sky: Robots acquire useful skills from experiences that would be too rare, costly or destructive to stage repeatedly, and a successor inherits an experimentally calibrated library of interactions rather than a pile of videos.
candidates.constraint: The scarce object is trustworthy action-conditioned experience with transferable contact dynamics and outcomes, not attractive generated footage.
candidates.invention: A task-specific world-model/physics hybrid that actively identifies the uncertain physical parameters, generates discriminating recovery experiences, and trains a bounded recovery controller with an explicit validity envelope.
candidates.out_transform: Change production of experience: construct informative near-failure interactions instead of waiting for accidental failures or collecting large indiscriminate datasets.
candidates.first_kernel_dependent_offering: For one integrator-owned bench and fixture, deliver a transferable recovery controller plus calibrated experience generator that enables an agreed jam/slip recovery on withheld physical instances under fixed time and intervention limits. Buyer is the integrator accountable for task throughput.
candidates.kernel_removal: Remove calibrated counterfactual interaction generation and parameter-identification loop; the held-out recovery gain must disappear relative to equally resourced conventional simulation/domain randomization and demonstration learning. Merely removing a branded compiler is irrelevant. If an ordinary scripted simulator or free blueprint ties, exclusive kernel advantage fails, although a separately evidenced integration service could remain useful.
candidates.strongest_alternative: NVIDIA open Cosmos Data Factory/checkers plus Isaac/MuJoCo and a capable current-AI robotics engineer; Google demonstrated calibrated action primitives; buyer internal team; more demonstrations; wait.
candidates.smallest_decisive_test: One customer-owned fixture with withheld real interaction outcomes, predeclared recovery success and intervention criteria, matched compute/data/time conventional baseline, removal of learned/calibrated interaction module, and cost per accepted real recovery including failed trials.
candidates.what_was_actually_done: Current release/access/prerequisite checks and incumbent-substitute analysis. No generator, model, controller or robot mission executed in this bounded reopened search.
candidates.essential_access_gap: No robot, raw outcome trace, contact calibration, authorized provider service or model compute was accessed. A local analytic/MuJoCo surrogate can test code plumbing but cannot replace real transfer in this offer.
candidates.commercial_gap: No paying integrator task, measured downtime/throughput benefit, qualified outside cost, distribution route or contract. Free/current-AI alternatives already cover much of construction; synthesis alone has no supported price.
candidates.decision: REJECT replacement flagship in this campaign. Preserve as a conditional opening only.
candidates.stop_gate: Do not construct a polished synthetic-video demo and call it successful robot work. Reopen only with actual usable fixture/data access and a predeclared transfer test plus complete-cost budget; reject if conventional baseline ties accepted performance at equal/lower complete cost.
candidates.billion_condition: Annual attributable productive value must sum from deployed machines times measured net benefit; neither eligible machine count nor per-machine incremental benefit is measured. No billion forecast.

candidates.name: Local-feedstock material recipe commons
candidates.priority: Rejected for essential physical construction gap
candidates.blue_sky: Small regional producers transform heterogeneous local by-products into dependable construction inputs, so material abundance is less dependent on a few standardized virgin feedstocks.
candidates.constraint: Composition variability, process interaction, curing and long-run performance make transfer of a nominal recipe unreliable. Knowledge retrieval is only one input.
candidates.invention: An adaptive characterization-to-recipe process with shared experimental design, measured uncertainty and batch-specific qualification; participants share only the information needed to establish a recipe validity envelope.
candidates.out_transform: Change what counts as a usable feedstock by constructing the characterization/qualification process, rather than merely minimize cost inside a fixed recipe catalogue.
candidates.first_kernel_dependent_offering: A physically made and independently tested, batch-specific nonstructural material recipe delivered to one producer under agreed performance, feedstock and process bounds, with explicit retest/withdrawal conditions. No structural approval is implied.
candidates.kernel_removal: Without the adaptive characterization and qualification instrument, the same heterogeneous feedstock must fail the agreed qualification or require materially greater accepted-outcome cost. Literature recommendations or a simulated compressive-strength score alone do not exercise this kernel.
candidates.strongest_alternative: Producer materials engineers and established experimental design; commercial laboratories; Microsoft Discovery-style literature/hypothesis tools; conventional mixtures and certified inputs; do nothing.
candidates.smallest_decisive_test: Produce held-out batches from two independently sampled feedstock lots, preregister application-specific material performance and cost acceptance, compare competent conventional recipe development on matched assays, and include failed batches and disposal/retesting in costs.
candidates.what_was_actually_done: Read October 20 incumbent case and earlier MatterGen abstract; distinguish rapid hypotheses from actual materials qualification. No samples, synthesis, assays or mixture model were executed.
candidates.essential_access_gap: No material lots, lab apparatus, qualified test services or authorized physical-production agreement. A software screening report would remove the essential construction and is not a valid substitute.
candidates.commercial_gap: No contracted producer, accepted specification, lab quote, royaltyable rights or measured per-tonne saving. Incumbent collaboration shows active pursuit, not an overlooked uncontested market or WTP for this offer.
candidates.stop_gate: No expansion until an actual producer-specific qualification problem, usable sample/lab access and capped comparative physical experiment exist. Reject if the same feedstock is qualified as cheaply using standard recipes and conventional design of experiments.
candidates.billion_condition: Net value must come from accepted annual tonnage times net verified benefit per tonne after qualification and upkeep; neither factor established. Do not apply a materials-industry TAM to a hypothetical recipe.

candidates.name: A private cross-owner experimental instrument
candidates.priority: Most locally programmable candidate; rejected for mechanism and commercial evidence
candidates.blue_sky: Organizations can jointly discover interventions that no individual data owner has enough evidence to evaluate, while retaining meaningful control over disclosure and reuse.
candidates.constraint: Owners lack individually sufficient evidence and cannot release raw data. Consent, heterogeneous measurements, incentive compatibility and output leakage remain binding even if arithmetic is encrypted.
candidates.invention: A purpose-specific joint experiment contract combining local randomization/measurement, disclosure-controlled sufficient statistics and participant compensation; supports a new joint estimand and records when privacy or heterogeneity makes it unanswerable.
candidates.out_transform: Change the available scientific action from isolated analysis to an authorized joint experiment, rather than simply automate an existing analyst report.
candidates.first_kernel_dependent_offering: For an already authorized consortium, execute and deliver one preregistered cross-owner experiment whose accepted conclusion cannot be obtained at any participating site alone under the same information budget. Buyer is consortium research/operations budget owner; all data owners need a concrete participation benefit.
candidates.kernel_removal: Remove the joint experiment/controlled release mechanism while holding data transfer prohibitions fixed: the same accepted estimand should become unidentifiable or lose its promised precision. Replace it with competent DataSHIELD/SecretFlow plus current AI: if it still works at comparable complete cost, a novel transformation or advantage is not established.
candidates.strongest_alternative: DataSHIELD, SecretFlow/established secure aggregation, authorized trusted research environment, conventional consortium analyst, or waiting. Quine is a separate restricted research capability and cannot serve as an assumed accessible engine.
candidates.smallest_decisive_test: On genuinely authorized, differently distributed site data, freeze estimand and disclosure/participation constraints; compare permitted joint output, site-only outputs and strongest free implementation; charge agreements, harmonization, security review and participant compensation. Synthetic arithmetic equivalence is insufficient.
candidates.what_was_actually_done: Rechecked mature open alternatives and September 29 Quine access; analyzed kernel-removal and same-scope substitute. Did not execute a new secure system, acquire data or recruit participants.
candidates.essential_access_gap: CPU computation can be implemented locally, but no authorized multi-owner data, participant contract or experimentally valid measurement harmonization is present. Synthetic parties erase the critical participation barrier.
candidates.commercial_gap: No paid consortium need, measured governance savings or lower complete cost than existing tools. The new frontier does not establish a newly available privacy or incentive mechanism; AI coding speed alone is not the kernel.
candidates.stop_gate: Reopen only with an existing authorized consortium whose required joint operation is unsupported or uneconomic with the strongest mature alternative, and measured participant benefit. Reject if ordinary federation meets acceptance with comparable complete cost.
candidates.billion_condition: No measured count or value of otherwise impossible experiments. Broad research spending or a hypothetical rare discovery is not a defensible billion-scale calculation.

additional_rejected_shortcut.name: Quine-powered virtual intervention delivery
additional_rejected_shortcut.reason: September 29 announcement is scientifically relevant but access is fellows/selected collaborators, and reported utility includes real wet-lab validation. A locally substituted language model plus hypothetical biological outputs cannot establish the essential capability. No candidate based on Quine production access was selected.

economic_rule.expression: Expected complete-cost surplus = accepted receipts minus discovery, construction, rejected attempts, compute, human exceptions, qualification, acquisition, support, refunds, retention and financing.
economic_rule.application: All three reopened candidates lack measured essential accepted-output costs and beneficiary participation data. No positive price/volume/demand curve was assigned to force a result. Their rejection means not earned within this campaign, not universal technical or business impossibility.
economic_rule.value_of_information: A follow-on experiment may be justified by a specific decision it can change and a capped complete cost. This record assigns neither an invented rare-success probability nor an enormous imagined terminal payoff.

kernel_test_hierarchy: Functional operator necessary for specified output is weaker than a new productive capability.
New productive capability is weaker than an accepted same-scope offering.
A successful alternative implementation defeats exclusive method advantage but need not defeat a separately established market.
Here EventWeaver has conventional parity and negative modeled economics; the broader transformative commercial chain is not supported.
The three reopened hypotheses need essential physical/institutional demonstrations that this campaign did not execute.
preservation: No original technical/source/confirmation/business files or results modified.
